g.text: [more than 10 sign-in attempts from this address in a minute]
Compare the password against the bcrypt hash
[credentials invalid, or the account is banned]
Store the access token and set the auth cookie
Silent refresh, on any later request
Rotate the refresh token and issue a new access token
Refresh the auth cookie as well as the store
The credential routes are rate-limited per address: 10 a minute on
sign-in and 5 on registration, against 60 everywhere else (NFR-05).
The cookie is refreshed as well as the client store. Before
Phase Q it was written only at sign-in, so every session died
silently after 15 minutes and unsaved editor work was lost.
